parts.name: Translation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the translation blade of a utility knife, made of stainless steel. It is a thin, sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function. It can extend and retract through a sliding mechanism for safety and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the body of the knife, translating in and out of the casing to expose or hide the cutting edge.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a utility knife, made of durable ABS plastic. It forms the main structure and housing for the blade.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides grip, houses the blade, and supports the sliding mechanism for blade adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the handle and structural support for the moving blade.
